full_judgment: 4. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record appearing for the petitioner submits that after due inquiry conducted by concerned department came to a definite finding that there was no lease in favour of the writ-petitioner and there was no record in the office which shown lease in favour of the writ petitioner and as such the High Court Division should have on these admitted facts passed an order vacting the order of status-quo and thereby depriving the writ petitioner from taking unlawful benefits.
